name: Kelli Peterson
career_history: Senior Estimator at Lithko Contracting, 10/2021 to present; Lead Estimator at Mark Young Construction, 4/2018 to 10/2021; Senior Project Coordinator/Estimator at CONCRETE STRUCTURES, 1/2015 to 3/2018; Construction Estimator at Groathouse Construction, 1/2002 to 2/2007
education: BA, International Economics, University Of Colorado Boulder, 2008 to 2012
biography: 15+ years in commercial construction estimating. 12 years as a "lead" or "senior" estimator, compiling accurate pricing, per plans and specs, by running a team of estimators. More than $700 million in estimates completed for projects seen through construction completion. Experience in ground-up, tenet improvement, municipal, retail, warehouse, data center and health care projects ranging from $250,000 to $30 million. Training of dozens of new estimators. Preparing initial schedules and general requirements based on front-end specifications. Growing and maintaining relationships with hundreds of subcontractors and suppliers. Communication with design teams throughout preconstruction. Project handoff to operations team, with buyout options, and best value information.
